summary: A 1981 BLM groundhouse watching over the Sheldon National Wildlife Refuge's high desert, one of only three fire lookouts left standing in Nevada.

facts.design: 9' x 9' groundhouse with wooden catwalk on 2' foundation

access.note: Within Sheldon National Wildlife Refuge; no visitor or access information found.

events.note: 9' x 9' groundhouse with wooden catwalk on a 2' foundation

notes_for_editor: Only one substantive source exists (the NHLR register page, cached locally); the FFLA list just repeats the same register number without added detail. No NRHP nomination, BLM press material, newspaper coverage, or trail/visit guide turned up in three web searches. Two oddities worth a human look: (1) the NHLR page says the lookout is 'administered by' and 'cooperated' with the Bureau of Land Management, yet Sheldon National Wildlife Refuge is normally a US Fish & Wildlife Service property — I found no independent source to confirm or correct this, so left the tower record's agency field as-is rather than guess. (2) FFLA's coordinates (41.83586, -119.62492) sit about 1.7 km from NHLR's (41.850064, -119.63278) despite citing the same register number US 301/NV 2 — already captured in the tower record's own conflicts field; no third source to break the tie, so no correction proposed here.
